question: NABARD launched a sanitation literacy campaign to promote literacy on water, sanitation and hygiene under which of the following missions in Karnataka in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanitation literacy campaign.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development, NABARD is embarking on a **Sanitation Literacy Campaign** in Karnataka__.
 
• It will create awareness on** good hygiene and sanitation practices among rural masses.**
 
• The campaign will commence on 2 Oct 2020 and continue until 26 Jan 2021.
 
• Under Swachh Bharat Mission, they also supported the construction of 3.29 crore household toilets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
